pageDescription: Manage the active workspace, its team, permissions, and settings. Use the switcher at the top to change or create another workspace.
createDescription: Create a separate environment for another brand, project, or client. It will start with its own Creator trial.
settingsDescription: The name, plan, and data below belong only to the selected workspace.
teamDescription: Manage who collaborates in this space and their permissions.
upgradeTitle: Collaboration is available on Growth and Pro
upgradeDescription: Creator and trial workspaces allow only the owner. Upgrade this workspace to invite people.
invitationSent: Invitation created. Copy the link to simulate email delivery.
limitReached: Every seat in this plan is occupied or reserved by a pending invitation.
workspaceScopedNote: Members, invitations, and billing are exclusive to this workspace.
